accept.holdDescription: You said yes. Your producer has the last word next.

actionCopy.softBookedMeaning: Said yes, waiting on you. Not booked until you book it.
actionCopy.tierConceptNote: Casts are asked in priority order. Asking starts with the first round. If it can't fill the date, you open the next round.
actionCopy.dateSourceNote: You can add a date by hand here. If your workspace syncs from Airtable, those dates keep updating on their own, and a date you add here is not changed by a sync.
actionCopy.unrestrictedEligibility: This date has no cast limits, so anyone in {{org}} can be booked here.

cancel.title: Cancel {{artist}}'s booking?
cancel.understudyLine: If {{artist}} is in the main cast, the understudy who has been waiting longest and said yes moves up automatically.
cancel.whoHearsFallback: The artist is notified in the app.

scope.berlin: Daily send times include their timezone.

scope.onlyConfirmationLive: Only the booking send hour is live.
scope.confirmationHourStillLive: The booking send hour still runs: it sets when booked artists are notified of schedule changes in the app.
